integrity: Full analytic derivation and a reproducible independent kinematic-line sampler are included. Numerical tests are not used as infinite proof. Historical priority is provisionally assessed, not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Motion-invariant lines conditioned on hitting a regular polygon; exact probabilities; known scale for single-probability inversion; no finite-sample guarantee. The result does not identify general irregular polygons.
title: A strict Crofton line-distance order for every regular polygon
